subject: errors generated trying to setup progenesisQIP csv output in r for msstats

messages.author: 6d33c9b2ba249bed
messages.subject: errors generated trying to setup progenesisQIP csv output in r for msstats
parts:
I was trying to read a prognosis QIP csv output file and it generated the following error.

What is wrong in my setups? Two different computers. Same errors.

1) 
Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "rt") :
  cannot open file 'FD_Ig_171119nk.cvs': No such file or directory

 then using another file saved as another name it comes up with following 
error.
2)
> raw <- read.csv("B4rem_msstats_full_nov19.csv", sep=";") head(raw)
Error: unexpected symbol in "raw<-read.csv("B4rem_msstats_full_nov19.csv", sep=";") head"


3) 
Error: unexpected symbol in "raw <- read.csv("PE1_fdata_70920.csv", sep=";") head"

messages.author: 2889aa2e61425c8e
messages.subject: Re: errors generated trying to setup progenesisQIP csv output in r for msstats
parts:
Dear Nel,

In the first case, it appears that your R working directory differs from the directory where the file is located. Use "getwd()" to check that, and "setwd()" to change the working directory.

In the last two cases, when you write two commands on a same line, they should be separated by a ";"

HTH 
Olga
